correctness.rationale: Exact u-coordinate recurrence and monotonicity split trajectories. Positive and negative ballistic classes are open, nonempty; connectedness yields critical boundary and an order-ratio argument excludes a second. The critical tail comparison w_n>=C/y_n validates the cancellation estimate for (w_n^2-w_{n+1}^2)/(1/y_n-1/y_{n+1}); limit 2a/d yields y_n~(9ad/2)^(1/3)n^(2/3), w_n~2(9ad/2)^(1/3)/(3d)n^(-1/3). Algebraic conjugacy was tested with exact fractions; finite shooting corroborates coefficients but is not the proof.

value.rationale: The no-equilibrium regime admits a unique globally selected nonballistic orbit separating two open, opposite escape basins. Its sharp 2/3 escape exponent and 1/3 transverse approach coefficient are structurally meaningful dynamical signatures, not a fixed-point or an arbitrary finite slice; they quantify a critical case invisible to studies reporting only attracting or chaotic transients. The result is limited to an explicit natural sign sector, without a claim of paper-sized scope.
